== dry-run, no sessions
[dry-run] legacy-socket check: tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-<lane> for each lane (refuses if any exists)
[dry-run] tmux -L t1 new-session -d -s t1-meta -c @WORK@/repo @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh t1 meta
[dry-run] tmux -L t1 new-session -d -s t1-api -c @WORK@/repo @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh t1 api
[dry-run] tmux -L t1 new-session -d -s t1-ui -c @WORK@/repo @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh t1 ui
[dry-run] would write @WORK@/warp/t1-team.yaml:
# Written by scripts/meta-launch.sh from @WORK@/state/meta/team.json; rerun it rather than editing.
name: t1 team
windows:
  - tabs:
      - title: t1
        layout:
          split_direction: vertical
          panes:
            - cwd: @WORK@/repo
              commands:
                - exec: tmux -L t1 new -A -s t1-meta -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh t1 meta'
            - split_direction: horizontal
              panes:
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo
                  commands:
                    - exec: tmux -L t1 new -A -s t1-api -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh t1 api'
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo
                  commands:
                    - exec: tmux -L t1 new -A -s t1-ui -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh t1 ui'
rc=0
== launch
tmux t1-meta: started
tmux t1-api: started
tmux t1-ui: started
warp: @WORK@/warp/t1-team.yaml
rc=0

== dry-run, exited lane
[dry-run] legacy-socket check: tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-<lane> for each lane (refuses if any exists)
[dry-run] tmux -L t1 respawn-pane -k -t t1-api @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh t1 api
[dry-run] would write @WORK@/warp/t1-team.yaml:

== tmux calls
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-meta
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-api
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-ui
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-meta
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-api
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-ui
tmux new-session -d -s keepalive sleep\ 600
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-meta
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-api
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-ui
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-meta
tmux -L t1 new-session -d -s t1-meta -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh\ t1\ meta
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-api
tmux -L t1 new-session -d -s t1-api -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh\ t1\ api
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-ui
tmux -L t1 new-session -d -s t1-ui -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh\ t1\ ui
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-meta
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-api
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-ui
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-api
tmux kill-session -t t1-api
tmux new-session -d -s t1-api bash
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-meta
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-api
tmux -L legacy-golden has-session -t =t1-ui
tmux -L t1 has-session -t =t1-api
tmux -L t1 display-message -p -t =t1-api: \#\{pane_pid\}
== lane api, fresh
--session-id|@ID@|-n|t1-api|API kickoff
line two $HOME "quoted" 'single'|
== lane api, resumed
--resume|@ID@|-n|t1-api|
== lane api, resumed, AW_META_CLAUDE_ARGS
--model|x|--verbose|--resume|@ID@|-n|t1-api|
== lane ui, no prompt
--session-id|@ID@|-n|t1-ui|
== lane ui, fresh, AW_META_CLAUDE_ARGS
--model|x|--session-id|@ID@|-n|t1-ui|
== lane meta
role-set --session @ID@ --name t1-meta
== bad lane
meta-lane: bad name 'Bad Lane' (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)
rc=2
